newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huangshan Tourism plans 40 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan Tourism plans 40 mln A shares.

text.p: China's Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd plans to make an offer of 40 million A shares in Shanghai in April, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The company, which listed 80 million B shares in Shanghai last November, expects the China Securities Regulatory Commission to approve the A share offer later this month.
It has named Anhui Provincial Securities Co as lead underwriter, the spokesman told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The spokesman did not say what the price would be.
Huangshan Tourism plans to use the money to renovate the Huangshan Hotel in the eastern province of Anhui, the official said.
Huangshan Tourism's 1996 net profit could beat the target of 65 million yuan under international accounting standards, the official said.
In its B share prospectus, Huangshan Tourism said it had net profit of 43.31 million yuan in 1995 and 29.22 million yuan the previous year under international standards.
The company said it would use B share proceeds to build a cableway at the Huangshan mountain resort and renovate hotel facilities.
Huangshan has 193 million outstanding shares, comprising 113 million state shares and 80 million B shares.
